body.input: Which companies opened an office in Finland in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, the following companies have opened or announced plans to open offices/facilities in Finland in 2026:

- **DayOne** — The Singapore-based private data center infrastructure company announced plans to develop a flagship hyperscale data center in Lahti, Finland.

- **Orientation Marketing** — The UK-based marketing agency opened a new office in Espoo, Finland, to serve its growing client base in the Nordic and EU regions.

- **Multinational CAVS Programme Office** — A multinational programme office for the Common Armoured Vehicle System (CAVS) project, led by Finland and centred around the Patria 6x6 armoured vehicle, was opened in Tampere, Finland.

- **Heitman** (via **Talli** platform) — US real estate investment manager Heitman launched Talli, a Nordic drive-up self-storage platform, following the acquisition of a majority stake in Finnish developer Talliosake's rental operating business, with an initial portfolio of 15 properties (11 in Finland, 4 in Sweden).

This list reflects what is available from current sources and may not be exhaustive.

| Deutsche AM | European Property Debt Fund II | The investment strategy targets sectors including logistics, residential, student housing, and prime office. | Deutsche Asset Management has held the first close of the fund, securing €120m in commitments from institutional investors. | [...] Talli will be led by Talliosake’s existing management team, with Talliosake retaining a minority stake in the business. Since 2010, the Finnish company has delivered more than 6,400 drive-up self-storage units across 230 properties in Finland and Sweden.  
  
The partnership marks a shift in Talliosake’s business model, which has traditionally focused on developing and selling individual self-storage units. Talli will instead adopt a develop-to-hold strategy, developing and operating income-generating properties for long-term ownership.  
  
Heitman and the management team plan to expand the platform across Finland and Sweden, targeting demand from both residential and business customers in what they describe as fragmented and undersupplied markets. [...] US real estate investment manager Heitman has launched Talli, a Nordic drive-up self-storage platform, following the acquisition of a majority stake in the rental operating business of Finnish developer Talliosake.  
  
The platform launches with an initial portfolio of 15 properties, comprising 11 in Finland and four in Sweden, and a pipeline of further growth opportunities. The transaction, completed on behalf of Heitman’s European value strategy, builds on the investor’s expansion into the Nordic self-storage market through its acquisition of Swedish platform Servistore in 2024.
